थ The seventeenth consonant of the Deva Nagri alphabet, and second
of the dental class; the aspirate of the preceding letter, and express-
ed by Th.

थ n. (थं)
 1. Auspiciousness.
 2. Fear, terror, 3. Preserving, preservation.
m. (थः)
 1. A mountain.
 2.

. A disease.
 E. स्था to stand,
affix ड.
